classification: Unofficial local score proxies. Official scoring weights are private.

historical.inputs: Doors include unlocked door events, matching the historical implementation.

secondary.formula: Dot product of weights and features in the listed order.

comparison.ranking: For comparable policies on identical valid completed rows, descending total exits and then descending mean of each profile. Historical score remains unchanged.
comparison.paired_win_tie_loss: Compare (exit difference, score difference rounded to 9 decimal places) lexicographically with (0,0), independently for each profile.
comparison.failure_handling: Retain attempt and failure counts separately. Never impute an episode result. Exact repeated attempt keys invalidate that model/key for a matched comparison.
comparison.global_ranking_scope: Only shared valid completed units across all compared policies. Preserve failed, missing and unmatched units separately.
comparison.pairwise_scope: Only shared valid completed units across the two named policies. Reports are descriptive if the minimum frozen suite was not completed.

bootstrap.scope: Mean left-minus-right paired differences for raw outcomes and unofficial numerical scores.
bootstrap.unit: Independent layout family. Calculate each layout mean over its matched engine and policy seed pairs, then resample complete layout groups with replacement.
bootstrap.method: Equal-tailed percentile interval, linear interpolation between adjacent order statistics.
bootstrap.incomplete_layout_policy: All planned seed pairs for the layout are required for an interval. Display matched point estimates on observed pairs separately.
bootstrap.small_sample_policy: Mark the interval unverified and expose actual layout and pair counts.
